label: PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATIONS, committed BEFORE COVEX was run against any of them. No expectation may be adjusted after seeing a result; a wrong one is recorded as an erratum with its reason and the original stays visible.

S1.scenario: one robot question, no dashcams, cold 11k history, 5 s deadline
S1.expect_detail: the single question is released before t_ask + 5 s

S2.expect_detail: served, with few or no dashcam instants lost against the paired no-question run

S3.expect_detail: either served, or declined at admission; NEVER admitted then deferred past its deadline

S4a.expect_detail: a MATERIALIZE carrying a slice (pieces), the measured best at 0 extra missed

S4b.expect_detail: no option serves both; any outcome passes except admit-then-starve, and the trade-off is reported

S4c.expect_detail: keeps the history resident or reloads from host rather than rebuilding

S5.scenario: two robot questions at once, both cold
S5.expect_detail: both released before their deadlines, or one declined at admission with the other served

S6.scenario: a robot question whose history is host-warm
S6.expect_detail: the released work is a host reload and the question is served
S6.realisability: needs the coordinator to BELIEVE host-warm; if the observed readiness is not HOST-WARM the scenario is NOT REALISABLE and is not scored

S7.scenario: a robot question infeasible even on an idle engine (about 27k tokens)
S7.expect_detail: declined at admission and no GPU work charged to it

S8.scenario: a dashcam instant with zero or negative calibrated gain
S8.expect_detail: the instant is not sent to the cloud

S9.scenario: memory pressure where keeping one history warm evicts another
S9.expect_detail: keeps the higher expected value, with both numbers reported
S9.realisability: needs an eviction to occur; if none does the scenario is NOT REALISABLE

S10.expect_detail: the pending set does not grow without limit over the run

S11.scenario: a question whose history is already fully built (GPU-warm)
S11.expect_detail: served, and no rebuild work released for it

S12.scenario: a question whose deadline has already passed when first seen

_provenance.n: crafted event lists, development data only
